title: Phase 2 - Mass communication SMS API (for EPRS only)

storage.value:
Acceptance criteria

for EPRS only The existing SMS communication service in the system must be replaced with the new service.

Service documentation

Authorization token

USniczCAmjPZP2UhWLibvxsvi7qIew9L

 

 

Sending a single SMS

Parameres:
import_id -> SMS id from Phoenix
message to -> Customer phone number from Phoenix
message text -> SMS body from Phoenix

Parameters from response
id -> Should be recorded in Phoenix and should be used for checking SMS status

Endpoint

http://10.236.19.188:3950/buffer_import_sms/sendSMS

 

Sending multiple SMS (up to 10)

Parameters
import_id -> SMS id from Phoenix
message to -> Customer phone number from Phoenix
message text -> SMS body from Phoenix

Parameters from response
id -> Should be recorded in Phoenix and should be used for checking SMS status

Endpoint

http://10.236.19.188:3950/buffer_import_sms/sendSMS

 

 

Creating a list of SMS for sending as a package (up to 100)

 

Parameters:
import_id -> SMS id from Phoenix
message to -> Customer phone number from Phoenix
message text -> SMS body from Phoenix

Parameters from response
buffer_import_sms_id -> Should be recorded in Phoenix and should be used for checking SMS status

Endpoint
http://10.236.19.188:3950/buffer_import_sms/mulltiInsSMS/0

Important note: Should perform “Sending all SMS form all created packages” step to send SMS

 

Sending all SMS form all created packages

http://10.236.19.188:3950/buffer_import_sms/sendAprSMS

Checking SMS status

Parameters:

id -> id or buffer_import_sms_id stored in Phoenix from previous steps
